consent.title: Help improve aurora spots?
consent.body: Share anonymous usage — we count which spots people view and navigate to (never who you are, never your location, just spot names and the hour). You can say no and everything works the same.
consent.footnote: You can change this later in Settings.
consent.toggleOnHelper: Sharing anonymous spot views and navigation taps.

personalAnalyticsConsent.title: Share personal analytics with us?
personalAnalyticsConsent.body: This is separate from the anonymous counts above and asked separately. It links a random ID for this install of the app (not your name, email, or any account — the app has none) to app opens, screen views, spot views, navigation taps, shares, alert opt-ins, language changes, and the Trip mode toggle state. Processed by PostHog in the EU. You can say no and everything works the same.
personalAnalyticsConsent.footnote: You can change this later in Settings.
personalAnalyticsConsent.toggleOnHelper: Sharing app opens, screen views, and feature use, tagged with a random ID for this install.
personalAnalyticsConsent.whatIncludes: What this includes: app opens, screen views, spot views, navigation taps, shares, alert opt-ins, language changes, and the Trip mode toggle state — each tagged with a random ID for this install, processed by PostHog in the EU.
personalAnalyticsConsent.whatNeverIncludes: What this never includes: your exact location, advertising IDs, cross-app tracking, session recordings, or automatic capture of everything you tap.

tourismConsent.title: Help improve tourism in Tromsø?
tourismConsent.body: Aurora can use your location to understand which areas and northern-lights spots people actually visit. Your precise location stays on your phone — the app only sends anonymous, area-level notes like "someone spent a while at Ersfjordbotn this evening", never your coordinates and never who you are. Only while the app is open. You can say no and everything works the same.
tourismConsent.footnote: You can change this any time in Settings.
tourismConsent.description: Help Aurora understand which areas and aurora spots are being visited. Location is processed on your device — your precise location is never sent to Aurora. Only anonymous spot- and area-level information is contributed, and only while the app is open.
tourismConsent.whatLeaves: What leaves your phone: which spots you visit and roughly how long you stay, which recommended spot you actually went to, and coarse areas where you stop for a while at night while exploring — never your exact position, and never linked to you.
tourismConsent.toggleOnHelper: Contributing anonymous spot- and area-level visits while the app is open.
tourismConsent.toggleOffHelper: Off. No location-derived data is shared.
tourismConsent.permissionMissingHelper: Location access is off for this app, so nothing is being measured. Turn it on in your phone's settings to contribute.
